summary: Second review. e34b63b4 was REFUSED by me: broad_candidates() screened a pre-market-only detector with the grouped-daily high/low, which I measured to be REGULAR-SESSION ONLY on 6/6 symbols 09-17 (AEMD daily 9.5/6.01 vs pre-market 14/1.26) - not a safe superset; plus the candidate-window mutant survived. At e0f97b72 (3 codex-marked commits, rules commit 5e7e813 precedes evidence commit e0f97b7): screen is now per-symbol MINUTE aggs 04:00-09:30, max high >= min low x 1.20 - a true necessary condition for any 30/60 s pair - then the one-second test, then raw trades; adjusted AND unadjusted prior closes, a symbol-day whose $1 eligibility differs is excluded and NAMED; splits in window listed; 09-17 excluded from calibration and disclosed as seen (14/16 detections); consequence frozen (>3 of 30 SUSPECT rejects the >10 band, nearest-rank P95, never below 10; the study changes no runtime behaviour). Replay side unchanged from my first read: production normalize_raw_trade + MomentumPaperEngine, PATH-vs-union reconciliation aborts on mismatch, capture refused before 16:00 ET. 22/22 from the PR worktree, ruff clean. MY MUTATIONS, all RED then restored: M1 window one second short (SURVIVED last round) ; M2 premarket screen tightened to 1.5x (3 fail incl. the tight-RTH/wide-premarket fixture); M3 split disagreement silently included; M4 band boundary >3 -> >=3; M5 capture allowed before 16:00. INDEPENDENT CHECK of the committed 09-17 control, run by me on the box after the close with the PR's own functions: all 32 listed minute-screen symbols pass the minute screen and exactly 7 pass the one-second test - AEMD BIAF CLDI DAIC MKDW RETO WETO - identical to the control's full-scan set. Six symbols of MY choosing outside the 32: TURB (x4.71, one-second candidate), NUWE, QCLS pass the screen but have prior closes 0.8935 / 0.815 / 0.964 -> correctly excluded by the $1 floor; MNOV, FTFT, MYSZ fail both levels. The control honestly reports that the rejected daily screen ALSO kept 7/7 on this day - mechanism proven, no dropped instance measured. Could NOT verify: the 11,776-symbol full scan itself (23,555 calls; I re-ran 38 symbols), and minute-vs-second aggregate eligibility parity beyond these. No calibration tape exists yet; results unseen by either agent.
